name: Thetanuts legacy IndexVault zero-cost remint
summary: IndexVault.mint() computes each required component-vault transfer with truncating division and accepts zero amounts. After claiming flash-borrowed index shares cut totalSupply to three, the attacker made 37 sub-supply mints whose transfers all rounded to zero, reminted the shares to repay the loan, and kept the five component-vault balances.
notes: Loss is valued at realised proceeds (rule 15): the BTCUSD and ETHUSD component shares taken from the index were redeemed in the exploit for the USDC listed; the AVAXUSD, BNBUSD and MATICUSD vaults held no USDC at the exploit block and the attacker never redeemed those shares, so they carry $0.

The later removeVault and setAaveAddressProvider calls on the index only pruned components and changed a provider setting; neither created the rounding defect or the empty-supply path, which existed from deployment.

Sibling TN-IDX-WBTC-CALL 0x95c59daf was drained the same way 300 blocks later by self-declared whitehat 0x03ab37cb (tx 0x4c0a75e2), which messaged Thetanuts' deployer to return the shares; treated as a rescue, not campaign or loss.
